summary: Iteration 7 regression smoke pass. Verified asyncio.wait_for(45s) wrapper in gpay_service.login() is syntactically valid and backend serves normally in MOCK mode. All 7 backend pytest cases pass; all 4 frontend routes load with 0 JS console errors; /setup shows gpay-accounts panel with gpay-count='1 active / 3 total'. Timeout code path itself (real login) cannot be exercised in preview because BOT_MOCK_MODE=true short-circuits before wait_for; verified by code review of gpay_service.py lines 66-78.

smoke_results.POST /api/gpay/accounts (mock): 200 - account.id + is_logged_in=true + login.ok=true + login.mock=true; no password_enc
smoke_results.PATCH /api/gpay/accounts/{id} {password:: 200 - triggers mock re-login; is_logged_in remains true
smoke_results.GET /api/transactions/stats: 200 - 5 counters present (total, received, not_received, utr_not_found, duplicate)
smoke_results.Frontend / /transactions /test /setup: All 4 routes load; [data-testid=gpay-accounts] present; [data-testid=gpay-count]='1 active / 3 total'; 0 console errors

code_review_of_wait_for_wrapper: gpay_service.py:66-78 correctly wraps _do_real_login in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=45.0), catches asyncio.TimeoutError, calls await self.close() to clean up Playwright resources, and returns {ok: False, timeout: True, message: ...}. Mock branch (lines 67-71) returns before wait_for so preview behavior is unaffected. Docker-compose default flip BOT_MOCK_MODE:-true is a safe user-experience fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Timeout path could not be exercised in preview (MOCK_MODE=true skips real login). Recommend main agent add a unit test that patches _do_real_login with an async sleep >45s to validate the timeout branch, if desired.
gpay_service.py is 366 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold but still fine. Consider splitting _AccountSession into its own module later.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter7 GPay account was created and deleted within test lifecycle; no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview always runs BOT_MOCK_MODE=true. The docker-compose change only impacts user's local Windows env. Real-login timeout branch of gpay_service.login() is only reachable when MOCK_MODE=false; cannot be validated in preview without env override. Existing test suites: test_iteration_2..7 in /app/backend/tests/.
